stories.title: The Secret Empire
stories.why: An important political crisis for Steve’s ideals.
stories.match: The Epic Collection covers #160–179; this is the 1970s Secret Empire, not the 2017 event.

stories.title: The Captain
stories.why: Steve’s conflict over who owns the symbol becomes the central question.
stories.match: Matched by exact ISBN and collection title in the supplied catalog. Open the library record to check borrowing.

stories.title: Operation Rebirth

stories.title: The Winter Soldier
stories.why: A strong modern entry point built around espionage and Steve’s past.
stories.match: The Premier Collection has the core arc; it skips #10. Do not confuse it with Brubaker’s separate 2011 relaunch.

stories.title: The Death of Captain America
stories.why: A major legacy story that follows the Winter Soldier era and Civil War.
stories.match: Read all three volumes in listed order: #25–30, #31–36, then #37–42.

stories.title: Man Out of Time
stories.issues: Captain America: Man Out of Time #1–5
stories.why: A compact introduction to Steve’s displacement into the modern world.
stories.match: A later retelling of his early modern-day adjustment; placed here by publication.

stories.title: Sam Wilson: Captain America
stories.why: A different bearer of the shield confronts what representing America means.
stories.match: Sam Wilson is Captain America here; this is a new starting point within the same universe.
